tours.name: Required Fields on a New Time Off Type

name_i18n.en_US: Required Fields on a New Time Off Type

tours.description: Learn what happens when you save a time off type without a name.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn what happens when you save a time off type without a name.

steps.title: Open Time Off
steps.description: Time off types are managed in the Time Off app.

description_i18n.en_US: Time off types are managed in the Time Off app.

steps.title: Configuration menu
steps.description: The Configuration menu holds the lists used by the Time Off app.

description_i18n.en_US: The Configuration menu holds the lists used by the Time Off app.

steps.title: Time Off Types
steps.description: Each type is a kind of leave that employees can request.

description_i18n.en_US: Each type is a kind of leave that employees can request.

steps.title: New
steps.content: Click New to start a time off type.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to start a time off type.

steps.description: The form opens empty. Leave the required fields empty on purpose to see how Odoo protects the data.

description_i18n.en_US: The form opens empty. Leave the required fields empty on purpose to see how Odoo protects the data.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon without filling anything in.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon without filling anything in.

steps.description: Odoo checks the required fields when you save. A record with a required field left empty can never be stored.

description_i18n.en_US: Odoo checks the required fields when you save. A record with a required field left empty can never be stored.

steps.title: Read the message
steps.content: Read the red message. Click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Read the red message. Click it to continue.

steps.description: The message names the type name, which is required. Employees choose a type by its name when they request leave, so it cannot be empty.

description_i18n.en_US: The message names the type name, which is required. Employees choose a type by its name when they request leave, so it cannot be empty.

steps.title: Discard
steps.content: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

steps.description: Nothing was stored. The red outline on the field shows what is missing. Fill it in and save again to create a real time off type.

description_i18n.en_US: Nothing was stored. The red outline on the field shows what is missing. Fill it in and save again to create a real time off type.
